text: In Kripke semantics, when is □φ true at a world w?
choices: When φ is true at w itself
When φ is true at some world accessible from w
When φ is true at every world accessible from w
When φ is true at no world accessible from w
explanation: □φ (necessity) is true at w iff φ holds at every R-accessible world. Choice 1 is the clause for ◇φ (possibility), which needs only one accessible world. Choice 0 ignores accessibility entirely, and choice 3 describes ¬◇φ.
